summary: Regression smoke for the big refactor of backend/portal/routes.py -> backend/portal/routes/ package (21 domain modules). Behavior is verified 1:1 identical: 63/63 pytest smoke tests pass (100%) covering all 21 domains — auth, client portal, admin_core, billing, lifecycle, tickets (create+reply+close cleanup), catalog (incl. public /portal-public/products no-auth), business (CRM/projects/followups/content-calendar), finance (summary/detailed/credit-notes/assets/expenses/kas-kecil/salaries/sales-fees), documents (HTML + %PDF-verified), integrations (v2 + legacy hub + modules), NOC/MikroTik, security, CMS + public (landing-content, branding, public/articles, public/status, sitemap.xml), email admin, DCIM (prefixes/racks/ips/sites), users admin (users/user-access-catalog/audit-logs), system (health/version/backup-history), plus RBAC regression (sales -> 403 on /admin/invoices). Frontend UI smoke: login at /portal/login succeeds with admin creds, redirects to /portal/admin/dashboard, sidebar fully rendered, admin-notif-bell present, and 7 critical admin pages (invoices, services, tickets, products, finance, integrations, site-content) all render without errors or blank state. NO destructive endpoints were invoked. No regressions found from the routes.py split.
critical_code_review_comments: Refactor result verified functionally: 63 smoke assertions across all 21 sub-router domains return expected 2xx with correct payload shape. Parent router include order in backend/portal/routes/__init__.py is correct (no shadowing observed at runtime).
Documents domain: /api/portal/documents/invoice/{iid} returns valid HTML and PDF (%PDF header present) — WeasyPrint pipeline still wired correctly through the extracted documents.py module.
Public unauth endpoints still work correctly: /portal-public/products, /landing-content, /branding, /public/articles, /public/status, /sitemap.xml all reachable without auth after split.

RBAC preserved: sales@intercloud-digital.com (password Sales2026! per conftest — reviewer's 'SalesTest2026!' still stale) returns 403 on /admin/invoices, confirming role-guard decorators survived the module split.

Frontend confirms login route is /portal/login (not /login). All admin UI pages under /portal/admin/* render normally; sidebar navigation intact; no red console errors captured during navigation across 7 tested admin pages.

Login route in the SPA is /portal/login (not /login). Sales password is 'Sales2026!' per conftest autouse fixture — do NOT use 'SalesTest2026!'. New regression file /app/backend/tests/test_iter42_routes_split_smoke.py covers every domain and can be re-run as a fast (<5s) smoke for future refactors.
